title: Add social share buttons to listing detail pages — viral growth loop
description: Add share buttons to /listings/[id] that let members share their listings to Twitter/X, Facebook, and copy link. Pre-fill share copy with listing title + Barterkin URL. Use existing OG images (task 15) so shared links render rich previews. Track share events in PostHog (listing_shared). Add to listing detail page below the contact button. Acceptance: share buttons visible on public listing pages, copy-to-clipboard works, Twitter/Facebook share opens with pre-filled text, analytics fire, unit tests cover click handlers.
notes: Added X/Facebook/copy share actions with listing_shared analytics on public listing pages and unit coverage. Commit: 0d3555b.

title: Add Twilio SMS phone verification — trust badge for local trades
description: Add phone number verification via Twilio Verify API. Members enter phone number in profile edit, receive SMS code, verify to get a 'Phone Verified' badge on their profile and listings. Store verified phone in profiles.phone_verified (boolean) and profiles.phone_number (encrypted). Gate: only show badge when verified. Use Twilio Verify (not direct SMS) for compliance. Add to profile edit form, show badge in ListingCard and member profile. Acceptance: full verify flow works in test mode, badge shows when verified, hidden when not, unit tests cover verify action edge cases.
notes: Added Twilio Verify send/check actions, inline profile SMS verification UI, decrypted phone prefill, and unit coverage for verify edge cases. Commit: 5d9fe02.

title: Add annual billing option — $90/yr (2 months free) to increase LTV
description: Add annual Premium plan alongside monthly. Stripe: create annual price ($90/yr) in config, update checkout session to accept 'annual' plan param. UI: billing page shows monthly ($9/mo) vs annual ($90/yr, 'Save $18') toggle. Default to annual as 'Best value'. Update webhook to handle annual billing cycle. Acceptance: checkout works for annual plan, webhook updates tier correctly, billing page shows both options with savings callout, unit tests cover annual checkout.
